name: FaceApp
summary: AI-powered app for facial transformations and edits.
description:
AI-powered app for facial transformations and edits.

Age Transformation: Shows aging or rejuvenated versions of faces. Gender Swap: Alters facial features to appear as a different gender. Smile Enhancement: Adds smiles to photos. Hairstyle and Color Changes: Modifies hair appearance.
